summary_en: CSRI 17 Godo Kaisha launched a tender offer to acquire all outstanding shares of Kaji Technology at 7,957 yen per share from November 11 to December 23, 2026, with a minimum purchase target of 258,300 shares representing 67.14% ownership post-transaction. The target company's board approved the offer and recommended shareholder participation.
title_en: Notice of Commencement of Tender Offer for Common Shares of Kaji Technology Corporation (Securities Code: 6391) by CSRI 17 Godo Kaisha
translation_en_brief:
CSRI 17 Godo Kaisha, a special purpose acquisition entity established on October 8, 2026, commenced a tender offer on November 11, 2026 to acquire all ordinary shares of Kaji Technology Corporation at 7,957 yen per share. The offer period runs for 30 business days through December 23, 2026. The minimum purchase target is 258,300 shares, which would result in CSRI 17 holding 67.14% of outstanding shares following the transaction, calculated using the 16,425 voting rights as of September 30, 2026 disclosed in the target company's most recent interim report.

The tender offer is undertaken for the purpose of taking Kaji Technology private. CSRI 17 is fully owned by the CSRI Fund (企業支援総合研究所１号投資事業有限責任組合), which is managed and advised by CSRI (株式会社企業支援総合研究所). On the same date as the tender offer announcement, Kaji Technology's board of directors held a meeting and resolved to express support for the offer and recommend shareholders to tender their shares.
